function: Learned (PPO-LSTM) control of per-UAV excitation current weights in a UAV-swarm virtual antenna array, maximizing directivity and minimizing maximum sidelobe level under wind-induced position errors (pp. 7-8).
system: Virtual antenna array of 8 or 16 UAVs (isotropic elements, amplitude-only weights, GPS-synchronized phase) to a ground BS; 3 GHz; no RIS (pp. 5, 6, 10, 11).
method: Deep reinforcement learning: PPO with LSTM actor and Adam-based adaptive learning rate (PPO-LA), continuous actions, trained online by interaction with the simulator (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: array-factor directivity model with analytical wind-field position deviations (constant, linear shear, sinusoidal Dryden-like turbulence); no standardized channel model, dataset, or measurement (pp. 6-7).
test_conditions: Training curves given separately per wind type (constant, shear, turbulent) and swarm size (8, 16 UAVs); wind speed swept in Fig. 3d; no held-out condition tested (pp. 11-13).
baselines: Learned only: DDPG, DQN, SAC, and standard PPO; no non-learned comparison (particle swarm optimization only sets the initial wind-free array, p. 11).
metrics: Directivity D (dB), maximum sidelobe level M (dB), D/M ratio, cumulative reward, and convergence speed over training episodes (pp. 6, 11-13).
complexity: Big-O training complexity O(2|θπ|+|θv|+MaNaT|θπ|+MaNaV+MaNa(2|θπ|+|θv|)), execution O(MaNaT|θπ|), plus space complexity; no runtime or FLOPs (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 6: "we introduce the array factor index, which is given by" - Eq. (1) free-space array factor with analytical wind models (pp. 6-7); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured data used.
q2_support: p. 13: "Simulation results with 16 UAVs. (a) Directivity Training curve." - each swarm size and wind type has its own training run (Fig. 3a, p. 11); the claim of unseen wind patterns (p. 2) is not tested.
q3_support: p. 11: "(SAC) [62], and standard PPO [63] as the benchmark algorithms" - DDPG, DQN, SAC, PPO are all learned; no non-learned comparator is reported (PSO only sets the initial wind-free array).
q4_support: p. 10: "During the execution phase, the computational complexity of PPO-LA is O(Ma Na T" - training, execution, and space complexity orders are given in Sec. IV-E.
q5_support: p. 11: "The simulation runs for T = 100 s with discrete time steps" - results come from the authors' own simulation; no code or data link, and no public channel dataset, is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 6 (power and beam control of an aerial link) rather than 3 by the tie-break order. Learning acts on excitation weights, not on UAV trajectory or placement: positions are wind-disturbed, not controlled (p. 8). The only non-learned method is PSO, used to set the initial wind-free array (p. 11), not as a compared baseline, so the reviewer may confirm q3. The p. 1 abstract has a stray production fragment about author membership, ignored.
